reviews.text:
I discovered this center seven years ago by chance, when I decided to train my Maltese, Batu, and I haven't left since. Cristina and her entire team introduced me to the beauty of this world, inspiring me to pursue many of the dog disciplines they offer.
Cristina is extremely knowledgeable about her work; with her, I've achieved results I wouldn't have been able to achieve alone or anywhere else. She makes you understand what it truly means to live with a dog, in all its facets, to achieve the best possible life experience together.
She also employs a team as qualified as her, including Stefano and Valentina, who demonstrate passion and dedication to what they do every day.
I highly recommend her!!
